cards.card_text: A cluster of hyssop A branch of cedar A strand of scarlet yarn
cards.verse_text: Take a cluster of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin, and brush the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe.
cards.snippet: Take a cluster of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin, and brush the blood…

cards.card_text: If it has healed, the priest orders two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.
cards.verse_text: the priest shall order that two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.
cards.snippet: …shall order that two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.

cards.card_text: To purify the house, the priest takes two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop, and slaughters one bird over fresh water in a clay pot.
cards.verse_text: He is to take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop to purify the house; and he shall slaughter one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.
cards.snippet: He is to take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop to purify the house; and he shall slaughter one of the birds…

cards.card_text: Cedar wood with hyssop and scarlet wool Olive oil with frankincense and salt Acacia wood with incense and linen
cards.verse_text: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
cards.snippet: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.

cards.card_text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean dips hyssop in the water and sprinkles the tent, its furnishings and the people who were there.
cards.verse_text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there.
cards.snippet: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings,…

cards.card_text: Solomon speaks of trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop growing in the wall.
cards.verse_text: He spoke of trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop growing in the wall, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
cards.snippet: He spoke of trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop growing in the wall, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and…

cards.card_text: Then he asks God to purify him with hyssop and to wash him.
cards.verse_text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
cards.snippet: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter…

cards.card_text: On a sponge on a stalk of hyssop In a cup on the tip of a spear In a jar raised up on a ladder
cards.verse_text: So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
cards.snippet: …soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.

cards.card_text: He proclaims every commandment of the law to all the people, then takes the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool and hyssop.
cards.verse_text: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
cards.snippet: …the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,

cards.card_text: Moses has the blood of calves and goats, plus water, scarlet wool and hyssop.
